description: Look up one Peruvian taxpayer by its 11-digit RUC in SUNAT's published taxpayer register: registered name (razon social), taxpayer status (active, deregistered, suspended ...), domicile condition (habido / no habido ...) and, for companies, the registered address with its ubigeo and department. Companies and organisations only (RUC prefix 20, plus government offices 00): natural persons (RUCs beginning 10, 15, 17) are excluded and answer found:false with reason natural_person_not_served, no name, status or address. Use for "is RUC 20100070970 real and active", KYC and counterparty checks, or resolving a RUC found on an invoice.
name: pe_ruc
title: Pe Ruc
